company.name: Mega Office Supplies
company.distributes: Breakroom confectionery and biscuits: Allens, Mentos, Werthers, Chupa Chups, Arnott's and Lotus Biscoff
company.channels_supplied: Online shop for businesses with national delivery
company.fit_rationale: Australian family business with a breakroom confectionery range of branded sweets and biscuits sold to offices with national reach, which includes Brisbane. Tier 3 because its head office address is not stated on the page seen. Storage: sells from its own stock through its web shop, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Memorial Shop at the Australian War Memorial
company.distributes: Biscuits and confectionery: RSL Anzac biscuits and gingernuts (Bakers' Finest), Jen's Traditional Biscuits and biscuit gift tins
company.channels_supplied: Memorial Shop at the Australian War Memorial in Canberra and its online shop
what_they_do_well: Sells RSL-endorsed Anzac biscuits from Bakers' Finest, tying its food range to Anzac Day commemoration.
company.fit_rationale: A Canberra gift shop with its own biscuits and confectionery collection selling other companies' packaged biscuits, with seasonal peaks around Anzac Day. It is tier 3 because food is a small part of a memorial gift range and the range shown is mainly Australian biscuits.

company.name: Mercha
company.distributes: Branded sweets (M&M's packs, Mentos) and custom branded confectionery
company.channels_supplied: Businesses through its web shop and B2B portal
company.fit_rationale: Sells branded M&M's packs and Mentos within a custom branded confectionery collection to businesses. It ranks in tier 3 because its confectionery range is small and its head office is not stated on its website. Storage: warehouse not named on its website; it supplies the branded packs decorated to order.

company.name: Mighty Ape Australia
company.distributes: Lollies and chocolate from other brands (Cadbury, Nestle, Pascall, Allen's, Delfi, Hubba Bubba)
company.channels_supplied: Online retailer shipping Australia-wide, with items sold by Mighty Ape and by marketplace sellers
company.fit_rationale: Online general retailer with a lollies and chocolate section that it sells from its own stock as well as through marketplace sellers. Tier 3 because its head office and Australian warehouse are not stated on the page checked.

company.name: Monsterzeug
company.distributes: Sweet and chocolate gifts, including a sweets gift box with Haribo gummies, Hanuta wafers, Valensina sweets and Mars chocolate bars
company.channels_supplied: Its Swiss online gift shop monsterzeug.ch, priced in CHF
what_they_do_well: Has run its online gift shop since 2008.
company.fit_rationale: An online gift shop with Swiss pricing whose 'Suesse Geschenke' and 'Schokoladen Geschenke' sections sell branded sweets and chocolate as gifts. It is based in Germany and its Swiss delivery terms are not stated on the pages seen, hence tier 3.

company.name: National Hotel Supplies
company.distributes: Guest room biscuits and sweets: Arnott's (Tim Tam, Scotch Finger, Butternut Snap), Lotus Biscoff, Little Bakes, Gumnut and Aussie Biscuits, Mentos mints, plus jams and condiments
company.channels_supplied: Accommodation industry Australia wide through its online shop
company.fit_rationale: A family run accommodation supplier with a Biscuits and Sweets section of other companies' branded biscuits and mints for hotel rooms. Diablo's biscuits, wafers and sweets fit this range directly. Tier 3 because its website names neither its head office city nor its warehouse. Storage: sells from its own stock through its online shop, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: National Museum of Australia Museum Shop
company.distributes: Chocolate (Chocamama chocolates and lolly mixes), confectionery from Nutworks (fudge, brittle, rocky road), Candy Kittens gourmet lollies, spreads and jams in its food section
company.channels_supplied: Museum Shop at the National Museum of Australia in Canberra and its online shop with pick-up in store
what_they_do_well: Runs a dedicated chocolate collection and a food section with sweets and spreads alongside its museum gifts.
company.fit_rationale: A Canberra gift shop with its own chocolate, sweets and spreads sections stocked with other companies' brands, including foreign gourmet sweets. It is tier 3 because food is one department of a wider museum gift range and store count is one.

company.name: New Age Promotions
company.distributes: Branded chocolate (M&M's, Lindt, Toblerone, Jaffas), sweets, mini muffins and cupcakes
company.fit_rationale: Its promotional confectionery collection includes M&M's, Lindt and Toblerone and sugar-free mints. It ranks in tier 3 because it is small and its head office is not stated on its website. Storage: warehouse not named on its website; it supplies the branded packs decorated to order.

company.name: Red Rhubarb Gifts
company.distributes: Customised corporate gift boxes with branded chocolate (Koko Black wafer chocolate), champagne, cheese boards and candles
company.channels_supplied: Corporate clients Australia-wide, with logo and message branding
what_they_do_well: Customises gifts with client logos and messages, packed by its own team in Brisbane.
company.fit_rationale: A Brisbane boutique corporate gifting service whose boxes pair branded chocolate with drinks and homewares. It names few food brands on its website and its boxes are drinks-led, hence tier 3. Storage: sells from its own stock, warehouse not named on its website.

company.name: Roses Only
company.distributes: Chocolate and sweets add-ons and gift boxes from other brands: Chocolatier chocolates, Bennetto chocolate, Random Harvest fudge, Rinaldi nougat and Kokopod coconut snacks.
company.channels_supplied: Its own online flower and gift shop with same-day delivery across Australia, including Melbourne.
what_they_do_well: Established in 1995 and now also serves Singapore, New York and London.
company.fit_rationale: National flower and gift retailer, founded in 1995 by a Sydney florist, that sells other brands' chocolate and sweets as gifts and add-ons, delivered same day in Melbourne. Flowers lead the range and its chocolate list is short, so it is tier 3.

company.name: Snowys Outdoors
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Hiking food and snacks including Offgrid Drifter bars, Clif energy bars and beef jerky
company.channels_supplied: Stores in Keswick (SA) and Brendale (QLD) plus its own online shop
company.fit_rationale: Outdoor and camping retailer with a hiking food and snacks shelf of branded bars. Tier 3 for its two stores and small snack range.

company.name: Style Bundle
company.distributes: Luxury and corporate gift hampers with chocolate (Koko Black) and gourmet food, alongside homewares and body care.
company.channels_supplied: Corporate clients in real estate, mortgage broking and property development across every Australian state, through its own online shop.
company.fit_rationale: Melbourne corporate gifting business that sources Koko Black chocolate among other brands for client hampers. Chocolate is one category among homewares and body care, so it is tier 3.

company.name: The Running Shop Australia
company.channel: Sports shops and sports nutrition shops
company.distributes: Chew bars from Precision Fuel and energy chews from Clif
company.channels_supplied: One store in Burleigh Heads, Gold Coast, plus its own online shop
company.fit_rationale: Gold Coast running shop with a small nutrition shelf of branded bars and chews. Tier 3 for its single store and small food range.
